verdict.rationale: New Relic is a SaaS observability platform that ships AI features, so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from AI model training. The pack has no evidence of an AI-training opt-out or a no-training commitment. Controls for disabling log collection and the local-only Diagnostics CLI data are adjacent data-collection settings, not protection from model training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
